_comment: Files exempt from the sibling-test rule. Key = repo-relative path, value = reason. Keep this short.

files.src/runtime/strata/strata-http.ts: The gateway is exercised over real loopback HTTP by test/contract/strata-http.test.ts, including upstream readiness, credential isolation and cancellation.
files.src/server/control/routes/strata.ts: The registered routes are exercised through the core's real HTTP server and client by test/contract/strata-control.test.ts and test/e2e/strata-maintenance.test.ts.
files.src/server/public/static-assets.generate: Generated string constants (scripts/import-app-static.mjs); the served bytes are pinned by sha256 in the proxy-http replay fixtures.
files.src/runtime/litert-lm/host/ffi-bun.ts: bun:ffi bindings and the TinyCC stream shim; run only inside the compiled binaries, so covered by test/integration/litert-host.test.ts against a real library (LITERT_LM_TEST_LIB), not by vitest under Node.
files.src/runtime/foundry-local/host/ffi-bun.t: bun:ffi bindings; run only inside the compiled binaries, so covered by test/e2e/foundry-host.test.ts against a real library (FOUNDRY_LOCAL_TEST_LIB), not by vitest under Node.
files.src/runtime/geniex/host/ffi-bun.ts: bun:ffi bindings to geniex.dll; run only inside the compiled binaries' Worker, so covered by test/integration/geniex-host.test.ts against the real SDK (GENIEX_TEST_LIB), not by vitest under Node.
